content: function CheckForManifestUpdate [SWS_PER_00576] Upstream: RS_PER_00013 , RS_AP_00119 , RS_AP_00120 , RS_AP_00127 , RS_AP_00128 , RS_AP_00135 , RS_AP_00139 , RS_AP_00159 ara::core::Result < bool > CheckForManifestUpdate () noexcept; Checks for updates of the Persistency Target Configuration. This method can be used to detect configuration updates that are installed by UCM while the Adaptive Application that uses Persistency is running. To re-read the updated Target Configuration, the Adaptive Application needs to call ara::per :: ReloadPersistencyManifest.
